desc_en: opting out of the rat race

sequence.py: Nǐ xiǎng bu xiǎng tǎng píng?
sequence.en: Do you feel like lying flat (躺平)?

sequence.cn: 别急着回答，先看看字面意思：躺下来，平平地躺着。
sequence.py: Bié jí zhe huídá, xiān kànkan zìmiàn yìsi: tǎng xiàlái, píngpíng de tǎng zhe.
sequence.en: Don't rush to answer — first look at the literal meaning: lie down, lie flat.

sequence.cn: 但现在，躺平是指——不努力，不竞争，怎么舒服怎么来。
sequence.py: Dàn xiànzài, tǎng píng shì zhǐ—— bù nǔlì, bù jìngzhēng, zěnme shūfu zěnme lái.
sequence.en: But now, 躺平 means: no striving, no competing — just do whatever's most comfortable.

sequence.cn: 小王以前是个工作狂，每天加班到最晚。
sequence.py: Xiǎo Wáng yǐqián shì gè gōngzuòkuáng, měitiān jiābān dào zuì wǎn.
sequence.en: Xiao Wang used to be a workaholic, working overtime the latest every day.

sequence.cn: 有一天，他突然发现——拼了三年，工资还是老样子。
sequence.py: Yǒu yìtiān, tā tūrán fāxiàn—— pīn le sān nián, gōngzī háishì lǎo yàngzi.
sequence.en: One day he suddenly realized — after grinding for three years, his salary was still the same.

sequence.cn: 于是他决定：不卷了，我要躺平！
sequence.py: Yúshì tā juédìng: bù juǎn le, wǒ yào tǎng píng!
sequence.en: So he decided: no more rat race — I'm going to lie flat!

sequence.cn: 现在的小王，六点准时下班，回家养花、遛狗、睡大觉。
sequence.py: Xiànzài de Xiǎo Wáng, liù diǎn zhǔnshí xiàbān, huí jiā yǎng huā, liù gǒu, shuì dà jiào.
sequence.en: Now Xiao Wang clocks out at six sharp, goes home to grow flowers, walk the dog, and sleep in.

sequence.cn: 同事问他后不后悔，他笑着说：我从来没这么快乐过。
sequence.py: Tóngshì wèn tā hòu bu hòuhuǐ, tā xiào zhe shuō: wǒ cónglái méi zhème kuàilè guò.
sequence.en: When a coworker asked if he regretted it, he smiled: I've never been this happy.

sequence.cn: 所以说，躺平不是懒，而是——不再为了别人的标准，累坏自己。
sequence.py: Suǒyǐ shuō, tǎng píng bú shì lǎn, érshì—— bú zài wèile biéren de biāozhǔn, lèi huài zìjǐ.
sequence.en: So, 躺平 isn't laziness — it's refusing to wear yourself out for someone else's standards.
